title: Signed Trail Junction
description: One static signed trail-junction scene for the original navigation route-marking scene program. One complete unchanged forked camping trail marker stands off the inside shoulder of a genuinely connected T-shaped scene-only route: a foreground arrival meets left and right branches. One complete unchanged low companion-scree cluster occupies the opposite rear shoulder as a visual landmark, leaving all three route arms and the central decision area clear. Both existing arrow boards, pegs, triangular mountain symbol, post and finite ground sleeve remain whole; no new arrow, destination label, map texture or flag colour is added. The whole scree geometry and all original per-face solid materials remain unchanged. Only the finite ground and two abutting closed route slabs are scene-only; the slabs are not new reusable road models. Two whole unit-scale unrotated instances from two published models: one scene and zero new independent models. This is a route-decision spatial arrangement, not the existing campsite with a marker beside its tents/fire/table, the forest straight-path vegetation composition, the small map-and-compass planning pad or an instrument survey station renamed. Static fictional visual arrangement only: no actual destination, direction, geographic placement, route planning, optical measurement, accessibility, load or route safety is asserted.
